title: land leaves the finished worker's worktree in a headless runner and the landing needs an extra round trip with the worker, because release_worker_worktree takes the runner's own worktree as the clone
goal: release_worker_worktree accepts a worker worktree directly under the .claude/worktrees of the clone that the runner's worktree belongs to (the common checkout's directory), so land removes a clean agent-* worktree and prints land: removed the finished worker's worktree, and no .claude/worktrees/agent-* worktree is left after a landing; it still refuses a worktree under another clone, a locked one not made by an agent, one with changes or a live process; a planted test covers the sibling case; found by the first supervised run (ST-opjydjc3) at Stage 3: the first land stopped at step branch, the runner asked the worker to detach and the agent-* worktree was left behind
